meta.description: A little time, well spent. A calm Pomodoro timer with a cup of tea or coffee. Focus, pause, and make room for a break.

timer.heading: One thing at a time.
timer.description: Settle in. Pick one thing. Let the rest wait.
timer.breakDescription: Stretch a little. Look away. Refill your cup.
timer.completeBody: Your focus session is complete. A little break is well deserved.
timer.breakCompleteBody: Your break is over. Your next cup is waiting.
timer.late: Your session finished while you were away.
timer.saved: Your timer stays with you, even after a refresh.
timer.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot save your session. Keep this page open to preserve it.
timer.resetDescription: This will clear the progress of your current session.
timer.modeLocked: Pause or finish this session before changing its length.

settings.title: Make yourself at home.
settings.description: A few small things, just the way you like them.
settings.durationHint: 1–180 minutes. Changes apply to your next session.
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 180.
settings.soundHint: A soft sound when your session ends.
settings.notificationHint: A notification when your session ends.
settings.denied: Notifications are blocked. You can allow them in your browser's site settings.
settings.unsupported: Notifications aren't available here. On iPhone or iPad, try adding Pomotea to your Home Screen first.
settings.failed: The notification couldn't be shown. Your timer still works here.
settings.limits: Keep Pomotea open for alerts. They may arrive late if your browser or device goes to sleep. With the app fully closed, no alert is sent.
settings.installTitle: A place on your Home Screen
settings.installHint: Use your browser's Install app or Add to Home Screen option. After your first online visit, the installed app can also work offline.

about.title: Small sessions. A little breathing room.
about.description: Pomotea is a simple Pomodoro timer. Give one thing your attention for 25 minutes, then step away for 5. After a few rounds, take a longer break. Adjust the rhythm to suit your day.
about.cup: As time passes, your cup empties. When it's empty, it's time to pause and refill. No streaks to keep. Just a little time for what matters.
about.privacy: Your preferences and timer stay in this browser. No account, tracking, or cloud sync.
